theme: Last night in Croatia before the long way home.
greeting: The sailing week is behind you, Dan — one quiet night in Cavtat, then a dawn start for the flights home to Tampa. Before you switch off, a few travel loose ends still need a hand while you're on dry land.

needsAttention.title: Rental car for the Tampa landing
needsAttention.detail: You land TPA tomorrow at 3:55 PM with no car booked. Lock in the full-size SUV (Sept 20–Oct 5) now, not jet-lagged at a Sunday walk-up counter.

needsAttention.title: St Pete beds for the 20th–21st
needsAttention.detail: The Orlando villa doesn't start until Sept 22, so the two nights right after you land still need somewhere in the St Pete area.

needsAttention.title: Cavtat early checkout + airport taxi
needsAttention.detail: You leave around 5:15 AM for the 7:30 flight. Confirm express checkout and the taxi with the hotel tonight, while you still have signal.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: Refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week — thin holiday inventory is exactly why this one was flagged to book early.

schedule.title: Off the boat at Komolac
schedule.detail: Charter ends at ACI Marina Dubrovnik; transfer to Cavtat

flagged.title: New gov-affairs VP roles in your alerts
flagged.detail: LinkedIn surfaced a VP, US Government Relations posting and a match to the Macy's VP Government Affairs role.

flagged.title: Venmo request — $50 for mowing
flagged.detail: Joshua Weaver requested $50 for lawn mowing dated 9/17.

flagged.title: Amex Membership Rewards redeemed
flagged.detail: Confirmation that points were redeemed on your card ending 3003.

inbox.noise: Everything else is newsletters, receipts, and travel confirmations — Uber, Apple, Substacks, subscription renewals.
inbox.clear: Nothing is waiting on your reply.

recipe.title: Vin santo–roasted pears
recipe.why: Early autumn brings the first ripe pears, and slow-roasting them coaxes out that season's deep, mellow sweetness.

acts.line: The last morning of the course — off the boat at Komolac and the Adriatic left in the wake.
One sea-view night in Cavtat: check in, drop the two duffels, let the week settle.
An early night — alarm near 5:15 AM, then Dubrovnik to Frankfurt to Tampa, landing 3:55 PM.
